task: The block level element list is a module constant behind util.isBlockLevel, so an extension cannot change it per instance. Move it onto the Markdown class. Add a class attribute Markdown.block_level_elements in markdown/core.py with the same names as util.BLOCK_LEVEL_ELEMENTS, and a method Markdown.is_block_level(tag) that returns True when tag is a string whose lowercased form, with any trailing slash removed, is in that list, and False for anything that is not a string, such as an ElementTree Comment tag. Keep util.isBlockLevel working but mark it deprecated with the existing util.deprecated decorator and the message "Use 'Markdown.is_block_level' instead." (you will need to move that decorator up the file). Then replace every call to isBlockLevel inside the markdown package with self.md.is_block_level, in preprocessors.py, postprocessors.py, treeprocessors.py and extensions/attr_list.py, and remove the now unused import from attr_list.py. No call to isBlockLevel may remain in the package outside its own definition. The rendered output must not change.
accept: PYTHONPATH=.bench-deps python3 -m unittest tests.test_apis.testETreeComments tests.test_apis.testElementTailTests tests.test_apis.TestBlockParser tests.test_apis.TestHtmlStash tests.test_apis.testSerializers tests.test_apis.testAtomicString tests.test_apis.TestEscapeAppend tests.test_apis.TestAncestorExclusion tests.test_legacy.TestBasic tests.test_legacy.TestMisc tests.test_legacy.TestPhp tests.test_legacy.TestPl2004 tests.test_legacy.TestPl2007 tests.test_syntax.blocks.test_paragraphs tests.test_syntax.blocks.test_code_blocks tests.test_syntax.blocks.test_headers tests.test_syntax.blocks.test_hr && test -z "$(grep -rn 'isBlockLevel' markdown --include='*.py' | grep -v 'def isBlockLevel')"
